ValidationRule.description: Created to ensure Refund Account is populated when Recovery Type = Credit Card Refund
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.VR_Credit_Card_Refund_Required_Fields__c=TRUE, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Connect', AND( ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Credit Card Refund'), ISPICKVAL(Refund_Account__c, '') ) )
